title: Idol of Shar

sources.title: Daughter of Darkness
markers: | description = Daughter of Darkness is the Companion quest for Shadowheart. It is automatically added to the journal if Shadowheart joins the party officially after the events of the Prologue.

summary: Offer the Idol of Shar to Shadowheart to unlock dialogue and an opportunity to gain approval.

fields.Trigger: Speak with Shadowheart while the player carries it, or have her pick it up. Additional interactions can occur when a Selûnite cleric is romancing her.
fields.Acquisition: On a pedestal past the trapped walkway in Grymforge, behind a gate with a lever.
fields.Base value: 400 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
